description: This file defines the WorkspaceTrackerInterface, an interface for managing workspace entity tracking in Drupal, including methods for tracking, retrieving, moving, and deleting entity associations across workspaces.

classes.name: WorkspaceTrackerInterface
classes.description: Interface for workspace tracking services, defining methods for managing entity associations within workspaces.

methods.name: trackEntity
methods.description: Updates or creates the association for a given entity and a workspace.

methods.name: getTrackedEntities
methods.description: Retrieves entities tracked by a workspace, optionally filtered by entity type and IDs.

methods.name: getTrackedEntitiesForListing
methods.description: Retrieves a paged list of tracked entities for a workspace.

methods.name: getAllTrackedRevisions
methods.description: Retrieves all revisions tracked by a workspace for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getTrackedInitialRevisions
methods.description: Retrieves revisions created in a workspace for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getEntityTrackingWorkspaceIds
methods.description: Gets list of workspace IDs where an entity is tracked.

methods.name: moveTrackedEntities
methods.description: Moves tracked entities from one workspace to another.

methods.name: deleteTrackedEntities
methods.description: Deletes workspace association records for specified entities.

methods.name: initializeWorkspace
methods.description: Initializes a workspace with associations from its parent.
